observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Large stage with wooden floor, classical pillars on the sides, and a blue-lit backdrop with abstract mountain or shield shapes.
observation.dancers: One male and one female dancer, dressed in traditional attire.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples performance on a large stage; dancers start together, separate across the stage, and rejoin or circle each other.
observation.posture: Upright and regal torso for both dancers, slight forward inclination or poised posture in movement.
observation.footwork: Gliding, smooth steps for the female dancer giving a floating appearance; quick precise steps and light leaps or turns for the male dancer.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held gracefully at shoulder or chest height with soft wrist and finger movements for the female; male holds arms in broader gestures, sometimes with hands framing the chest or extended outward.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright and controlled with minimal hip movement; fluid upper body carriage.
observation.partnering: Paired dance with moments of hand-holding, leading, and independent solo travel in spatial proximity.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Male dancer performs turns and low leaps; female dancer maintains a smooth, gliding low-level motion across the floor without jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Female wears a long white gown with a veil and headdress, and long dark braids; male wears a traditional white chokha (long tunic with cartridge details) over dark trousers and boots.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact weight transfer mechanics and precise footwork details are obscured by distance and low resolution in wide shots.

signature_moments.what: Male dancer performs rapid traveling turns with arms extended and controlled torso.
Male dancer executes brisk footwork and a leg kick while maintaining an upright posture.
Both dancers perform synchronous swirling turns across the stage facing each other.
